summary: Large batches of policy changes wait for a SuperAdmin's approval again.

fixes.title: Many policy changes wait for approval
fixes.text: Many policy changes in one run wait for approval again, and a SuperAdmin of the tenant approves them.

fixes.title: Warnings are amber, not red
fixes.text: Warnings now show in amber, so red means a real error.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The Guards page no longer shows a run counter, the Demo mode card appears only in a demo environment, and licensed installations are no longer told they update like Community.
